privacy.title: Privacy Notice & Data Governance
privacy.intro: This website is dedicated exclusively to Roseline Nga Maniack's undergraduate dissertation defense in Business Law. Respecting the privacy of guests and academic community members is a core priority.
privacy.collectedText: We only collect information you voluntarily submit: first name or nickname, attendance confirmation (RSVP), encouragement or tribute messages, and photos contributed to the memory album.
privacy.usageText: Submitted data is used solely for organizing the defense reception and curating the guestbook and photo album. No advertising trackers, third-party marketing cookies, or facial recognition systems are used.
privacy.exifText: Uploaded photos are processed to strip EXIF metadata, including GPS coordinates. No photo geolocation data is stored or displayed. Please note that no website can technically guarantee absolute prevention against screenshots by authorized viewers.
privacy.moderationText: Every guestbook message and uploaded photograph defaults to 'pending' status and only becomes visible after manual approval by the administrator.
privacy.removalText: You may request modification or permanent deletion of a message, RSVP, or photograph at any time using the removal request form or by contacting the organizer directly. Configured retention period:
